items.title: EU to Support Libya in the Fight Against Terrorism and for Border Security
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The European Union’s ambassador to Libya, Nicola Orlando, met yesterday in Tripoli with members of the 3+3 Joint Military Committee, which brings together representatives from Tripoli and Benghazi under the auspices of the Ministry of Defense and the General Command of the Libyan Arab Armed Forces. items.title: The first Senegalese selected for the “New Destinies” project visited the embassy
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Dakar, Michele Tommasi, welcomed the first twelve Senegalese workers who will soon take part in the “New Destinies – New Horizons” project in Italy, in the presence of representatives from institutions, training organizations, and partners involved in the initiative. items.titleIt: The first Senegalese selected for the “New Destinies” project visited the embassy

items.title: Kenya: Gachagua Warns Kenya 'Not Safe' for Foreigners, Cites Cross-Border Abductions, Deportations
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua has warned that Kenya is becoming unsafe for foreigners, accusing the Ruto administration of allowing a pattern of cross-border abductions, forced deportations and alleged transnational repression.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Gachagua Warns Kenya 'Not Safe' for Foreigners, Cites Cross-Border Abductions, Deportations

items.title: Kenya: U.S. Pledges $242mn for Ebola Response As Kenya Strengthens Regional Preparedness
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The United States has announced an additional $242 million to support immediate Ebola response, preparedness and humanitarian efforts in countries affected by or at risk from the outbreak in East and Central Africa.
items.titleIt: Kenya: U.S. Pledges $242mn for Ebola Response As Kenya Strengthens Regional Preparedness

items.title: Tigray rebels accuse Ethiopia of drone strikes amid fears of renewed war
items.description: Tigray rebel authorities have accused Ethiopia’s federal government of carrying out deadly drone strikes in the region, raising fears of a renewed conflict nearly four years after a peace deal ended a devastating two-year war.
items.titleIt: Tigray rebels accuse Ethiopia of drone strikes amid fears of renewed war

items.title: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to the Republic of Kenya and the Seychelles, Vincenzo Del Monaco, met with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya, Kamau Thugge, with whom he had “an important exchange of information.” “It was an opportunity to discuss the country’s economic situation,” the embassy noted, “and the growing bilateral relationship between Italy and Kenya.” Read article...
items.titleIt: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya

items.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
items.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

items.title: Sierra Leone president presses lawmakers to back contested election reforms
items.description: Sierra Leone’s President Julius Maada Bio has urged Parliament to pass disputed electoral reforms that would lower the presidential victory threshold, introduce proportional representation and reserve 30 percent of political leadership positions for women.
items.titleIt: Sierra Leone president presses lawmakers to back contested election reforms

items.title: An Alliance for Vocational Training in Mozambique with Italy’s Support
items.description: (ANSA) - MAPUTO, 06 AGO - Mozambique’s Minister of Youth and Sports, Caifadine Paulo Manasse, opened the workshop “Alliance for the Future: Co-Investing in Training, Nurturing Talent," in Maputo Province on Thursday, August 6, calling for a new strategic partnership between the government, industry, and development partners, with the goal of transforming vocational training into a driver of industrialization and job creation. items.title: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
items.description: Pope Leo called for peace in Sudan on Sunday during an address at the Vatican. Leo singled out El-Obeid, the beseiged capital of North Kordofan state. Residents are facing a lack food, water and medical supplies as fighting in the city continues.
items.titleIt: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
